steps: Wash the leaves, strip the tough stems and pound them to a paste in a mortar.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil until soft and add the tomatoes.
Stir in the leaves, add water to the same level and cook forty minutes on a low heat.
Add the ground peanuts and cook twenty minutes more, stirring.
Add the prawns, the whole piri-piri and salt and stew ten minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and warm it five minutes without letting it boil.
Serve with rice or with xima, the maize porridge.
